query: Analyze the sentiment of Instance A and Instance B. Instance A contains strong negative sentiment markers ('worst', 'disappointed', 'terrible', 'one star'). Instance B contains mixed but ultimately positive sentiment markers ('amazing', 'better film', 'major good time', 'great addition'). Identify the specific phrases in Instance B that drive the positive classification despite the 'negative' label in the prompt data.
expected_output: Identification of the semantic polarity of both instances and correction of the premise that Instance B is predicted negative. Identification of key positive phrases in Instance B (e.g., 'amazing', 'better film', 'major good time') and negative phrases in Instance A (e.g., 'worst', 'terrible', 'disappointed').
